  "say": "Before anyone places a domino, shall we agree on the animal and which end the start goes at? Otherwise we'll each build a different thing and the judge will get a very confusing pile.",
  "to": "everyone",

  "do": "stop",
  "notes": "Round start, table empty, no start domino, pad on table (untouched). Nobody has picked an animal yet. Wait for the plan, then take a job that fits. Watch the 2:00 pad removal."
}
